title: The False 'Expert' Overhead Trap
rules: Blacklist hiring high-salaried 'big-company experts' to scale a growing mid-market business; corporate executives import heavy systems, bloat overhead, and dilute operator culture.
Disregard lack of prior industry credentials when starting or acquiring a business; legacy experience creates rigid orthodoxy that kills opportunistic innovation.
Evaluate key hires on demonstrated style, intense curiosity, and independent conviction rather than conventional pedigree or corporate credentials.
